mutations.name: weekly audits the current week
mutations.find: const items = await runAudit(verbs, { week: previousWeek(now), judge: opts.judge, keepExisting: true }, now);
mutations.replace: const items = await runAudit(verbs, { week: isoWeek(now), judge: opts.judge, keepExisting: true }, now);
kills: titan-factory owner-gates weekly audits the previous ISO week, then files the demotion card with that audit consulted

mutations.name: weekly reports with no audit consulted
mutations.find: if (items) await reportAction(verbs, { deposit: true, auditBad: badByClass(items) }, now);
mutations.replace: if (items) await reportAction(verbs, { deposit: true }, now);
kills: titan-factory owner-gates weekly audits the previous ISO week, then files the demotion card with that audit consulted

mutations.name: weekly stops at an audit file already written
kills: titan-factory owner-gates weekly still reports when the previous week's audit file is already written

mutations.name: an unread incident log reads as no incidents
kills: titan-factory owner-gates audit reports incidents unknown when the factory state dir holds no incident log

mutations.name: the audit links incidents by no ancestry at all
kills: titan-factory owner-gates audit reads the incident log from the factory state dir and reports unknown when ancestry cannot answer
